What we do

Customs Brokerage Solutions for Compliant Shipments

Our portfolio combines strategy, development, deployment, and governance to address complex business challenges across customer experience and enterprise productivity.

Customs Documentation

Our team prepares accurate customs documentation and filing records that support timely clearance and reduce your documentation errors.

HS Tariff Classification

At KGS, you get reliable HS code classification that assign the correct tariff codes, supporting compliant declarations and accurate duty assessment.

Duty & Tax Calculation

We calculate duties, taxes, and applicable charges with precision, giving you greater visibility into landed costs and regulatory obligations.

Trade Compliance

Our domain-certified team manages regulatory requirements through regulatory reviews, screening, and filing practices that support compliant cross-border trade.

Import & Export Processing

Our import and export customs clearance specialists manage filings from submission through release to keep freight moving efficiently.

Customs Valuation

KGS provides you with accurate customs valuation backed by complete documentation and accepted valuation methods that withstand regulatory review.

FTA & Duty Optimization

We review trade agreements and duty structures to identify legitimate savings while maintaining full compliance with applicable regulations.

Denied Party Screening

Our screening process checks transactions against restricted party lists before shipment, strengthening compliance across international trade.

Make Smarter Customs Decisions for Stronger Trade Performance.

AI enhances customs brokerage through faster documentation, classification, and compliance. KGS implements intelligent automation for customs documentation and filings, identifying classification risks before submission, while real-time analytics improve duty visibility, compliance, and customs clearance.
